ac_tip: AC:Retrofitting PV system which includes PV inverter connected to PV panels and the grid. Panels cannot be directly connected to the hybrid energy storage inverter.
dc_tip: DC: 1. Newly installed PV system with hybrid energy storage inverter connected to PV panels directly. 2. Battery system without PV inverter connected to the grid directly and only charged from the grid.
feed_power_limit_set_in_system_settings: To set the feed-in power limit, please go to System Settings.
hybrid_tip: Hybrid: The whole system includes PV inverter connected to the grid and hybrid energy storage inverter connected to PV panels directly.
inverter_installed_capacity_tip: Total installed PV capacity connected to PV inverter
lfdi_tip: LFDI is automatically generated by the system after NMI information is submitted for IEEE 2030.5 Device Identification (CSIP-AUS) for DNSP
storage_pv_tips: Total installed PV capacity connected to energy storage inverter
